comments.author: @YOURNAME-mk2lb
comments.text: The way you are describing Azerbaijanis while showing Indians feels wrong. Azerbaijanis are usually fair-skinned, with brown or light-brown hair, but because many men work in physically demanding jobs under the sun due to economic and cultural circumstances, they get tanned. If you look at young Azerbaijani children, most of them are fair-skinned and have lighter-colored hair, and I’m the same myself, with blue eyes. My family isn’t mixed in any way. You don’t have to be mixed with Russians to have naturally lighter features, funny enough.
